rows.en: RVF-25 Messiah (Luca)\nThe VF-25's electronic-warfare custom. Luca's is light green.\nHas a big back radome and carries remote-piloted drones.
Queadluun-Rhea (Standard)\nEvolved Queadluun-Rau with a back beam cannon and better\narm weapons. Deployed mainly as the Pixie Team's mainstay.
rows.notes: 'Standard' coined for the generic (non-personal) unit suffix; used for every such unit in this slice.

rows.en: Queadluun-Rhea (Klan)\nKlan's personal unit, colored red. A powered suit by nature,\nit pairs with Klan's own skill to make a formidable machine.
Klan Klang\nPixie Team leader Captain Klan Klang, in her macronized form.\nRaging and grieving at Michel's death, she mowed down Vajra.
rows.notes: Zentran-ized rendered 'macronized' (terms.json).

rows.en: VB-6 Konig Monster\nA variable bomber based on the Monster. It excels at mobile\nhit-and-run attacks and boasts awesome, unrivaled firepower.
rows.notes: Konig without umlaut: o-umlaut is not in Shift-JIS (mecha.json note).

rows.en: Macross Quarter\nOnly ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the Macross name.\nThis agile, hard-hitting ship was once seized by pirates.
rows.notes: 'seized by pirates' follows the source literally.

rows.en: Battle Frontier\nThe linchpin of Frontier's defense: a huge multirole stealth\nattack space carrier. In a crisis, it houses the government.
Vajra (S)\nSmall type of an insect-like alien life form. Its head fires\nenergy blasts and homing missiles. Its tail blade allows melee.
rows.notes: Missile-like guided weapons compressed to 'homing missiles' to fit the unconfirmed width.

rows.en: Vajra (L)\nOver 5 times the small type's size, with great firepower: a big\nback beam that smashes battleships in one hit, missiles, guns.
rows.notes: Machine-gun-like weapons compressed to 'guns'.

rows.en: VF-27 Lucifer (Standard)\nBuilt from the YF-24 exclusively for cyborg soldiers. Its\nmobility is too extreme for a flesh-and-blood body to endure.
rows.notes: 'Standard' coined for the generic unit suffix.

rows.en: VF-27 Lucifer (Brera)\nBrera's personal VF-27, in his signature color, purple.\nIts high performance troubled Alto's team time and again.
Battle Galaxy\nMacross Galaxy's Battle-class carrier. Thought lost in a Vajra\nattack, it was in fact part of a plot by Grace and her allies.
VF-2SS Valkyrie II\nThe U.N. Forces' main Valkyrie, built with Zentradi technology.\nSilvie and others flew it with distinction against the Mardook.
Gigamesh (Standard)\nThe Mardook's main mobile weapon, made for melee, with\nclaws all over its body and wing cutters on its shoulders.
rows.notes: 'Standard' coined for the generic unit suffix.

rows.en: Gigamesh (Feff)\nFeff's personal Gigamesh, in his signature color, red.\nIt fought Silvie fiercely inside the ship as she tried to escape.
VF-1S Valkyrie (Barnrose)\nPersonal unit of Mariafokina Barnrose, leader of Vindirance.\nPilot skill or specs? Old as it is, it rivaled the newest units.
VF-19A Excalibur Ravens Type\nThe VF-19 of special forces unit VF-X Ravens. High-performing\nbut twitchy, it takes great skill to master.
rows.notes: Display name keeps 'Excalibur' because the source line includes it (mecha.json lists 'VF-19A Ravens Type'); same pattern as 'VF-19P Excalibur Patrol Type'.

rows.en: VF-22 Sturmvogel II (Wilbur)\nPersonal unit of Wilbur Garland, VF-X Ravens commander.\nIt showed off its might in purging the rebellious Vindirance.
VF-9 Cutlass (Max)\nOf the Dancing Skull squadron. Max's unit, in his signature\ncolor, blue, tore across the battlefield alongside Milia.
rows.notes: Dancing Skull squadron (Macross M3) is not in organizations.json.

rows.en: VF-9 Cutlass (Milia)\nOf the Dancing Skull squadron. Milia's unit, in her signature\ncolor, red, tore across the battlefield alongside Max.
rows.notes: Dancing Skull squadron (Macross M3) is not in organizations.json.

VF-0 Ghost Booster\nAll-out assault spec using Ghosts as boosters.

SV-51 Twin Booster\nDecisive-battle spec fitted with 2 jet boosters.
VF-1 Super Pack (TV)\nBooster units enhance firepower and thrust.
VF-1 Super Pack (Movie)\nThe Valkyrie's standard gear for space.
VF-1 Strike Pack\nStrike gear only leaders' units may carry.
VF-1 Armored Pack\nAdd-on armor with missiles mounted all over.
YF-19/VF-19A FAST Pack\nA compact FAST Pack designed for stealth.
YF-21/VF-22 FAST Pack\nA compact FAST Pack designed for stealth.

VF-11MAXL Kai Sound Booster\nFires sound beams powered by Song Energy.
VF-17T Kai Sound Booster\nFires sound beams powered by Song Energy.

VF-25 Super Pack\nThe Messiah's standard gear for space.
VF-25 Armored Pack\nArmored gear that transforms to all 3 modes.
Armored Pack (Final Battle Spec)\nFinal-battle spec: Armored plus a sniper rifle.
rows.notes: S-rifle read as 'sniper rifle' (in the final battle Alto's armored VF-25F carried the sniper rifle).

rows.en: VF-25 Fold Speaker\nA speaker that amplifies the effects of song.
VF-171EX Armored Pack\nArmored gear loaded with anti-Vajra weapons.
VF-2SS Super Armed Pack\nSAP: the Valkyrie II's standard equipment.
U.N. Forces pilot. Shot down by Nora, he washes up on Mayan\nIsland and meets Sara. They clash, but slowly bond.\nA fool who'd risk his life for a woman. (CV: Kenichi Suzumura)
rows.notes: CV: Kenichi Suzumura.

rows.en: U.N. Forces ace. A tough survivor of the Unification Wars and\na drinker whose motto is "Fear booze? Then you can't fight!"\nAbove all, a man who loves the open sky. (CV: Akira Kamiya)
rows.notes: Roy's motto rendered freely to fit: 'Fear booze? Then you can't fight!'. CV: Akira Kamiya.

rows.en: Priestess of Mayan Island, Guide of the Wind. Overly hostile\nto outsiders, she's hard on Shin too. But in the fight for AFOS\nfragments, she slowly bonds with him. (CV: Sanae Kobayashi)
An Anti-U.N. Forces pilot whose family the U.N. Forces killed.\nSkilled enough to down Shin twice, she teamed with Ivanov\nto run rings around the U.N. Forces. (CV: Minami Takayama)
Anti-U.N. Forces ace pilot and Focker's former instructor.\nKnown as "Daisy Ivanov," he flies well enough to treat Focker\nas a mere fledgling. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)
rows.notes: CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo (macrons dropped).

rows.en: A civilian pilot. Meeting Lynn Minmay, caught in a Zentradi\nattack, he becomes a military pilot to protect her. Indecisive,\nhe wavers between two women. (CV: Kenji Nojima)
rows.notes: Source grammar has Minmay as the one caught in the Zentradi attack; kept that reading. CV: Kenji Nojima.

rows.en: A veteran of the Unification Wars, as strong with drink and\nwomen as in combat. Hikaru's senior, adored as a big brother.\nSkull Squadron's leader and trusty ace. (CV: Akira Kamiya)
rows.notes: Rank-free 'senior' for the senpai relation; Hikaru adores him as a big brother. CV: Akira Kamiya.

rows.en: A pilot who shone from his very first sortie. Nickname: Max.\nHe beats the enemy ace Milia in battle, and this leads to him\nlater marrying the alien Milia. A rare talent. (CV: Sho Hayami)
rows.notes: CV: Sho Hayami (macron dropped).

rows.en: Ex-Zentradi pilot. She sneaked into the Macross to find the\none who shot her down. She found Max, dueled him and lost.\nHe then proposed, and they married. (CV: Eri Takeda)
rows.notes: Source says she was shot down, kept. Max is the one who proposes (passive in source). CV: Eri Takeda.

rows.en: Hikaru's subordinate, a big, happy-go-lucky guy. His jokes\nin battle get him in trouble; Hikaru or Max save him. A cheery,\neasygoing goof, hard to hate. Avg. skill. (CV: Katsumi Suzuki)
rows.notes: 'Avg. skill' abbreviated to fit. CV: Katsumi Suzuki.

rows.en: Support-character Misa does not appear.
rows.notes: Developer note (support Misa unused).

rows.en: Poster girl of Chinese diner Nyan-Nyan, she won Miss Macross\nand became a top idol. Free-spirited, she toyed with Hikaru's\ntender crush to her heart's content. (CV: Mari Iijima)
rows.notes: Chinese restaurant compressed to 'Chinese diner'. CV: Mari Iijima.

rows.en: The top idol of the Macross. Through the "Minmay Attack," she\ncaused a culture shock that ended the interstellar war. A\nlegendary diva remembered for generations. (CV: Mari Iijima)
rows.notes: Star-war term rendered 'the interstellar war' (not the formal Space War I term, which uses a different source word).

rows.en: Zentradi division commander. Warlike and hotheaded, he rides\nout front himself, bent on sinking the Macross. While many\nchose to live with Earth, he sought battle. (CV: Kosuke Meguro)
rows.notes: Division commander is literal for the source rank. CV reading Kosuke Meguro (macron dropped): flagged for a check.

rows.en: A Zentradi pilot. A formidable ace known as "Milia the Ace,"\nshe was feared even by the male Zentradi soldiers.\nAfter losing a battle to Max, she marries him. (CV: Eri Takeda)
U.N. Forces pilot Maximilian Jenius in macronized form. To\ncover the Macross in the final battle with the Boddole Zer Main\nFleet, he flew a Queadluun-Rau with Milia. (CV: Sho Hayami)
rows.notes: Boddole Zer Main Fleet per organizations.json.

rows.en: Giants created by the ancient Protoculture through genetic\nengineering. Bred as combatants, they never knew "Culture,"\nand overreact when they first encounter it.
rows.notes: Generic Zentradi soldier profile; no CV in source. Plural 'they' since no individual is named.

rows.en: Zentradi fleet commander. A master strategist, he corners the\nMacross again and again. Touched by forbidden Culture in that\nfight, he opts to coexist with Earth. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)
rows.notes: Vrlitwhai (TV). CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo.

rows.en: Zentradi fleet commander. Contact with Culture awakened the\nCulture asleep within him. In the final battle he turned on\nBoddole Zer to fight for the Macross. (CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo)
rows.notes: Vrlitwhai (DYRL/final battle). CV: Ryuzaburo Otomo.
